metadata.description: 6-Max Cash, 100bb. Hero opens SB to 3bb, BB 3-bets to 12bb. 4-bet to 26bb, call, or fold.

source.detail: Hand-authored from standard 6-max 100bb preflop theory. NOT solver output - these are reasonable reference ranges, not an equilibrium. Replace with solver exports when available.

spec.RAISE: JJ+, AQs, AKs, AKo, A5s-A3s, KQs
spec.DEFEND: JJ+, AQs, AKs, AKo, A5s-A3s, KQs, TT-55, AJs, ATs, KJs, KTs, QJs, QTs, JTs, T9s, 98s, AQo, AJo, KQo

explanations.RAISE: Blind versus blind, so BB 3-bets very wide and we can 4-bet for value with less than usual. The suited wheel aces and KQs are the bluffs.
explanations.CALL: We opened a wide range and BB is attacking it, so we defend a wide band of pairs, suited broadways and connectors rather than folding our way out of the pot.
explanations.FOLD: The bottom of a 43% opening range. Wide as BB's 3-bet is, these hands cannot profitably call out of position.
